name: Zhejiang Lianxiang Smart Home Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Lianxiang Smart Home Co., Ltd. focuses on the entire lifecycle of embroidered wall coverings within the Chinese market, from their research and development to manufacturing and ultimate sale. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses various wall covering styles, including intricate embroidery, jacquard, 'fine printing 230', Inca embroidered patterns, and modern digital prints. The company also produces collar embroidered curtains, all sold under its LEADSHOW brand. Established in 2004, the firm's headquarters are situated in Jiaxing, China.
